svg.text: One run on the pinned experiment profile
Seconds from the run epoch, to scale; the fault fires on time at T_inject = 360 s. Every request belongs to the window of its intended dispatch time.
fault phase, 600 s: degradation and recovery

held entry at 90 % of the pre-fault level: recovery (illustrative)
Near T_inject, magnified: an early fire (AC3 allows 500 ms either side)
The fire anchor is the earlier of T_inject and the recorded actual fire time. The baseline window ends one pinned client timeout (30 s)
before it. A request times out 30 s after its dispatch, and on a valid run dispatch trails t_i by at most the pinned 50 ms maximum
send skew, so every baseline request has ended by 50 ms after the fire anchor. The fault window starts at T_inject; times to recovery
are measured from the fire anchor (SPEC.md §3).
